name: Venapce operations
description: Expert-authored operation packages for the Venapce panel. Paste this repository's URL into Operations → Import to browse the catalog, or point the importer at a single package folder.

operations.name: Linux fleet HTTP audit
operations.description: Who is serving HTTP on the fleet, where, and under which hostnames — one Stage row per web server.

operations.name: GitHub commit security review
operations.description: Clone a repository, have a Claude agent read the last N commits in that checkout, and stage one row per security finding for a human to promote.
